name: branding-pale-cream-logomark-on-white-loading-frame
title: Pale Orbit-Heart Mark on White
whatItIs: A wide white frame with a small outline logomark in pale cream at the centre, two crossing loops forming a heart shape, like the first frame of a logo reveal.
whatItMeans: A nearly invisible mark on white sets up an animation reveal and feels calm and delicate.
techniques: Very low-contrast mark on white as a reveal start
Two crossing loops forming a heart

vocabulary.definition: An opening frame of an animation before the mark appears fully.
A logo drawn with one uniform stroke.
Two ellipses overlapping to create a symbol.
